name: pcdoctor-ai-xprize
description: FieldSpark AI — AI-operated customer continuity for service SMBs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fieldspark/api" "npm run dev -w @fieldspark/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fieldspark/contracts && npm run build -w @fieldspark/api && npm run build -w @fieldspark/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fieldspark/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @fieldspark/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @fieldspark/api && npm run typecheck -w @fieldspark/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:secrets
